input.change_text: Added support for loading `CLAUDE.md` files from additional directories specified via `--add-dir` flag (requires setting `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)

output.subject: Load CLAUDE.md from --add-dir directories (env-gated)
output.action_text: Set `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1` and pass `--add-dir <path>` to have Claude Code 2.1.20+ pick up `CLAUDE.md` files from extra directories. Env gate keeps the behavior opt-in; existing single-directory loading is unchanged when the flag is absent.
